summary: A manufacturer offers a single-device repair method in place of factory equipment that handles many devices together.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025), section 5. Washington allowed makers to withhold manuals and tools exclusive to machines that repair multiple devices at once if both owners and independent shops can obtain adequate alternatives.
inGame: needs: a shop requests access to equipment used exclusively for batch repairs.
gates: A shop requests access to equipment used exclusively for batch repairs.

turns.what: The independent shop can do the job one device at a time.
turns.pulledBy: The alternative completes the same repair.
turns.writesBack: The shop can take individual jobs.

turns.what: The proposed alternative leaves one operation out.
turns.pulledBy: The alternative cannot complete the repair.
turns.writesBack: The shop documents the missing capability.
